run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum removals from an array given a count n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum removal count
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold sorts an array and counts elements greater than or equal to cumulative sum
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by sorting a copy instead
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that iterates through sorted elements tracking cumulative sum for maximum removals
